summary.en: A machine-local service that owns session agents across a fleet, and the peer federation that makes two of them look like one.

description.en: muster is a service that runs on one machine and owns the session agents there: it starts them, keeps their state, and lets a caller read and send to them over a local interface. Two machines can be joined as peers so that their sessions look like one set. It is a background component that other apps install automatically as a dependency, so a person normally has no reason to install it by hand.

prompts: "muster: command not found": add ~/.local/bin to PATH, or set MUSTER_INSTALL_DIR to a directory already on it
An exact version: curl -fsSL <site>/muster/install.sh | MUSTER_VERSION=X.Y.Z sh
